definitions.T: selected nominal block target in seconds
definitions.W: Waterfound-selected nominal maturity-time objective in seconds, optional
definitions.D: Waterfound-selected minimum creation-to-spend height distance, optional
definitions.N: max(N_time,D) when both are selected; otherwise the selected component
definitions.first_spend: coinbase created at H is first spendable in block H+N

important_semantics: N*T is nominal target-time exposure, not guaranteed elapsed wall-clock time.
A fixed block count should not be copied across different T values when the objective is nominal time or expected work over time.
Expected chainwork per wall-clock time is approximately invariant across block targets at equal aggregate work rate.
Actual reorganization risk also depends on network conditions, DAA response, realized work and adversarial assumptions.
Timestamp-based maturity would add a new timestamp-dependent consensus rule and is not supported by current FAE maturity evidence.
Dynamic chainwork-threshold maturity remains research-only because it is not implemented/evidenced in the current candidate.

admissible_policy_inputs.minimum_height_distance_D: NORMATIVE_WATERFOUND_SELECTION informed by later network/reorg evidence

deterministic_derivation: After W/D/T are selected, N is mechanically derivable; the numeric maturity need not be independently hand-selected.
